text:
toni_sales: Quick kickoff \/ Acclaro wants to move from CompetitorX to Redwood. They asked for a focused POC to validate endpoint parity, measure token billing differences, and run through their security questionnaire. @ashwin_se can you own the tech path?

ashwin_se: I can lead. First asks from my side: 1) a scrubbed set of top-50 prompts, 2) 5 representative request traces, and 3) which endpoints are hot in prod (chat vs completions vs embeddings). Also need peak RPS and token histogram to size the POC.

marc_acclaro: We'll share a JSONL of 60 prompts and two traces. Main calls are /v1/chat and /v1/generate. Peak is ~120 rps, steady ~25 rps, avg token/window ~320. Sending a link to the scrubbed data via DM.

ops-bot: staging org created: acclaro-poc-stg (keys expire in 10 days).

ashwin_se: Suggested POC plan: Day 0: onboarding (keys, IP allowlist). Day 1: request/response mapping and smoke tests (500 side-by-side samples). Day 2: quality parity eval and small regression set from customer. Day 3: perf tuning (batching/KV cache) and cost delta report. Deliverables: mapping doc, parity report (sample diffs), and a 1-page cost comparison.

claire_security: Security checklist: they asked for SOC2 scope, KMS/HSM integration details, and egress IPs. We'll need completed questionnaire + architecture diagram to start review. Turnaround ~48h after docs arrive. Please have them email security@redwood.com and cc thread. Also flag: any PII in traces must be redacted.

ben_product: Model mapping note: CompetitorX "x-fast" roughly aligns with rwd-fast-1; "x-chat" to chat-rt. Known diffs: stop-token handling and system-message stitching. For parity harness, we'll add a prompt-normalization layer and canonicalize system messages to reduce noise. We'll record 200 diff samples for product review.

ashwin_se: Quick smoke example to give their engineers so they can validate connectivity: 
```
# CompetitorX example
POST https://api.competitorx.com/v1/generate
{ "prompt": "Extract action items:\n- Finish report\n- Ship v2", "max_tokens": 120 }
# Redwood equivalent
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY' \
  -d '{"input":"Extract action items:\n- Finish report\n- Ship v2","max_tokens":120}'
```
Include this in the POC pack.

marc_acclaro: Procurement timeline: we'd like a draft SOW and pricing bands by Thursday. Security will start the questionnaire tomorrow. Also need an explicit clause about data handling during POC (logs retention and deletion).

toni_sales: Pricing note: ballpark hosted commit discounts: ~25% for 6mo, ~35% for 12mo depending on volume. If they want Dedicated capacity we'll loop in finance for custom bands. I'll draft a SOW stub and send for quick review.

claire_security: For the POC we can offer a temporary KMS binding for test keys and a 14-day log retention policy if they require. We need them to confirm data classification and whether any EU residency is required.

ben_product: Operational fallback recommendation: enable a quantized 8-bit variant under load and log sample responses to the parity bucket. Also add a deterministic stop-token post-processing step in the harness to reduce spurious diffs. We'll include that in the appendix of the report.

ashwin_se: Action items: I'll post the 1-page POC plan + mapping doc by EOD tomorrow. Claire will confirm security turnaround and provide the questionnaire link. Ops will share IP allowlist + connection details. Toni will draft the SOW and pricing bands. Schedule: 30-min sync Friday 9:30am PT.

marc_acclaro: Confirmed 1B1 procurement & security points: procurement -> procurement@acclaro.com, security -> sec-lead@acclaro.com. They'll expect questionnaire within 24 hours.

ton i_sales: Thanks all 1B1 tagging @ashwin_se @claire_security. I'll send calendar invite and SOW stub. :thumbsup: 

(reacts: :rocket:, :eyes:)
